name: software-library-search
description: Search a curated catalog of GitHub tools and Hugging Face models. Return original source links, available setup notes and review dates. Results are a dated curated collection, not an exhaustive live search; the Actor does not install or run the listed tools.

interface.longDescription: Search a curated catalog of GitHub tools and Hugging Face models. Return original source links, available setup notes and review dates. Results are a dated curated collection, not an exhaustive live search; the Actor does not install or run the listed tools. Connect your own Apify account through OAuth. Runs are billed to that account under the Actor’s current pricing; ChatGPT or Codex subscription fees do not include Apify charges.
defaultPrompt: Find curated PDF tools and show their source links and review dates, within $0.01.
